description_short: Trace a stopped production chain to its first cause, diagnose exact logistics failures, and see buffer shortages before they stop the factory.
description_long: Factory Lens adds a compact diagnostics HUD and map overlay with Cause Trace, exact truck and transport diagnoses, and predictive buffer warnings. Select a problem to isolate the affected building, the first cause, and the product path between them. Distinguishes disabled import/export, unreachable routes, reserved deliveries, full destinations, missing jobs, no free trucks, and stalled or disconnected belts and pipes. Includes English and Russian localization. UI-only: it does not change simulation data or the save format.
